narrative.overview: A kinetic editorial portfolio where real artifacts anchor full-screen project chapters and measured language separates implemented work from next steps.

rules.name: Signal rule
rules.body: Orange carries voice and action; lime marks process and active state.

rules.name: Motion rule
rules.body: Motion follows reading progress and yields completely to reduced-motion preferences.

dos: Show real project output at useful scale.
Name build status and limitations plainly.
donts: Do not use generic project-card grids.
Do not add ornamental dashboards or invented claims.
